age.evidence: Six Wistar male adult rats were maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle

dosing.evidence: A 40 mg/kg dose (i.p.) was employed in this work... Dissolution of ibogaine-HCl to prepare the samples for intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection was carried out using warm saline

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 07.00 h)... Experimental sessions were conducted during the light period

enrichment_housing.evidence: transparent cages (40 × 30 × 20 cm3) containing wood shaving material — wood shaving is bedding, not enrichment; no other enrichment items mentioned

judge_notes: Paper is an intracranial EEG study; the primary outcomes are neural recordings (iEEG power, coherence, permutation entropy, neural-network classification of brain states). Per rubric, electrophysiology / EEG / LFP recordings are explicitly excluded from scoring even when done in awake behaving animals.
Sleep scoring based on iEEG+EMG was used to identify wake/NREM/REM states, but these are state classifications from neural recordings, not behavioural assays.
The authors mention 'abnormal motor behaviors' from a previous study but no behavioural assay (e.g., OFT, HTR) was conducted or quantified in the present work.
All three candidates correctly returned an empty assays list; consolidated output preserves this.

enrichment_housing: candidates split between 'no' and 'not_reported'. Paper only mentions wood shaving (bedding), not enrichment objects, and does not explicitly state absence of enrichment, so 'not_reported' with low confidence is preferred.
